metadata.description: BatchLSHLookup module architecture: T4 Batch + T10 Probabilistic + T1 Atomic tier composition for 10-100× batch LSH lookup amortization in kindly_dedup

q1-what-problem.problem: Sequential LSH bucket lookups in DedupPipeline::find_duplicates() create cache-inefficient scatter pattern

symptoms.symptom: 100K lookups/sec throughput limit (sequential band hash + bucket query)
~20μs per document LSH lookup (5 bands × ~4μs cache miss each)
Cache thrashing: Random bucket access pattern defeats prefetch
Memory bandwidth waste: Single lookup per cache line fetch

impact.metric: Pipeline bottleneck: LSH lookup dominates find_duplicates() at 40-60% time
Scalability limit: Thread contention on ConcurrentMapCapsule buckets
Cost: 10M corpus requires 200 seconds @ 50K lookups/sec (target: 50-100 sec)

q2-why-problem.root-cause: Sequential lookup pattern vs batch-friendly bucket structure

analysis.point: Current: for each doc → for each band → query bucket (scatter pattern)
Optimal: Batch all docs → prefetch buckets → amortized cache miss cost
ConcurrentMapCapsule optimized for bulk operations, not point queries
128K bucket capacity underutilized: <10% occupancy for 10K docs

q2-why-problem.missed-opportunity: T4 Batch tier batch processing (10-100× amortization) not applied to LSH phase

q3-who-affected.impact-severity: HIGH: LSH lookup is 40-60% of find_duplicates() latency

q4-when-occurs.scenario: Persistent pipeline incremental rebuild (100K weekly updates)
q4-when-occurs.frequency: Every duplicate detection operation (core pipeline function)

q5-where-occurs.context: After MinHash signature computation, before Jaccard verification

q6-how-manifests.observation: Profiling shows 40-60% time in bucket query loop (ConcurrentMapCapsule::get calls)
Cache miss rate: ~80% (random bucket access pattern)
Memory bandwidth: ~30% utilization (single lookup per fetch)
q6-how-manifests.measurement: Sequential: 100K lookups/sec vs Target batch: 150K-200K lookups/sec (1.5-2× gap)

q7-constraints.constraint: Vec pooling required: <10% memory overhead vs sequential
Zero recall regression: Batch must match sequential results exactly
Zero breaking changes: find_duplicates() API unchanged
batch-lsh feature flag for gradual rollout

q8-success-criteria.criterion: Speedup: 1.5-2× vs sequential baseline (fair comparison, same hardware)
Recall: 100% equivalence (batch == sequential results, property tested)
Memory: <10% overhead (Vec pool reuse, bounded allocation)
Testing: 45 T28 tests (15 unit + 10 property + 12 integration + 8 production)

q9-non-goals.non-goal: GPU LSH acceleration (deferred to T7 tier, separate module)
Adaptive batch sizing (deferred to Phase 2, focus on fixed 1000-doc batches)
Distributed LSH (deferred to T8 Network tier)
Breaking API changes (I20 zero breaking changes mandate)

steps.step: Reserve Vec pool capacity: signatures.len() × estimated_candidates_per_doc
For each signature: Compute 5 band hashes (25 rows each)
Batch bucket queries: Collect all bucket keys first (cache-friendly)
Bulk bucket read: Single pass over ConcurrentMapCapsule (prefetch-friendly)

algorithm.name: lookup_batch_parallel

steps.step: Chunk signatures into rayon batches (auto-determined by rayon)
Parallel: Each thread runs lookup_batch on chunk

algorithm.speedup: Linear scaling up to num_cores (validated: 16 cores = 15.2× in Phase 4.4)

steps.step: Calculate range: start = band_idx × 25, end = min(start + 25, 128)
Rolling hash: hash = hash × 31 + sig[i] for i in start..end

edge-cases.case: Empty signatures slice: Return empty Vec (0 candidates)

Hash collision: Multiple docs in same bucket (expected, not error)

decision.topic: Immutable buckets via Arc (no writes after build)
decision.rationale: Eliminate write contention, enable lockfree reads, simplify thread safety
decision.alternative: Mutable buckets with RwLock (rejected: 10-50× slower, mutex contention)
decision.impact: Zero write overhead, 100% lockfree reads, perfect for batch lookup pattern

decision.topic: Fixed batch size (1000 default, configurable via AtomicU64)
decision.rationale: Simple implementation, empirically validated optimal size
decision.alternative: Adaptive batch sizing (deferred: P2 complexity, minimal gain for P0)
decision.impact: Predictable memory allocation, simple tuning, future-proof for adaptive upgrade

decision.topic: Vec pool for candidate reuse (thread-local via rayon::ThreadLocal)
decision.rationale: Avoid malloc churn (>1μs per allocation), <10% memory overhead
decision.alternative: Fresh Vec allocation per lookup (rejected: 2× slower, memory fragmentation)
decision.impact: 1.1-1.2× secondary speedup, bounded memory growth, thread-safe via ThreadLocal

decision.topic: Scalar band hashing (SIMD deferred to portable_simd stabilization)
decision.rationale: Stable Rust compatibility, 2-8× SIMD speedup not blocking for 1.5-2× target
decision.alternative: Nightly-only SIMD (rejected: P0 requires stable Rust compatibility)
decision.impact: Stable Rust compatible, future SIMD upgrade path preserved, gradual optimization

decision.topic: Feature flag gradual rollout (batch-lsh disabled by default)
decision.rationale: Zero breaking changes, instant rollback, A/B testing in production
decision.alternative: Big Bang replacement (rejected: I20 recommends gradual for large changes)
decision.impact: Safe deployment, metrics-driven validation, zero downtime rollback

decision.topic: Infallible API (no Result returns, all operations succeed)
decision.rationale: Simplify error handling, empty buckets return empty Vec (not error)
decision.alternative: Result-based API (rejected: No recoverable errors, panic on OOM acceptable)
decision.impact: Simple API, zero error propagation overhead, Rust idiom (panic on unrecoverable)
